Components/Buttons

Icon button

A square button for an icon (Mantine's ActionIcon). Always give it a label.

Variants × colors
primarygrayredteal subtle (default) filled light outline default——— transparent raised gradient———

subtle is the icon button's default variant. label is the accessible name and the tooltip.

API

<ray-icon-button> · RayIconButton

Same properties as ray-button; variant defaults to subtle.

PropertyAttributeTypeDefaultDescription
labellabel reflectsstringAccessible name and tooltip (required: the button has no text).
variantvariant reflectsfilled | light | outline | subtle | default | transparent | gradient | raisedsubtleVisual style.
gradientgradient reflectsstringWith variant=gradient: "from to [deg]", palette colors or CSS colors ("teal blue 90"). Default: the --ray-gradient-* tokens.
colorcolorstringA palette color or any CSS color.
sizesize reflectsxs | sm | md | lg | xlsmWidth and height.
disableddisabledbooleanNot interactive.
loadingloadingbooleanShows a spinner instead of the icon.
SlotDescription
(default)The icon (an inline <svg> is sized to the button).
